children.text: The underlying platform for Frappe CRM is the powerful Frappe Framework. It allows you to rapidly build new data models or extend pre-existing ones.

Adding custom fields or tables is a breeze, and you can add quick automation using pluggable Python scripts. Frappe CRM offers a unified product experience out of the box, but with zero limits on customization.

children.text: Managing leads inside Meta's dashboard feels disconnected. Downloading CSVs or manually copying details allows leads to slip through the cracks.
Frappe CRM pulls every Meta lead straight into your pipeline with all the details filled in. Your team sees every lead right inside the CRM, exactly where it belongs.
And it doesn't stop there. Frappe CRM also supports Exotel and Twilio CTI & SMS integrations to ensure you are connected with your customers on every channel.

image.alt: Omni-channel Integrations with Meta, Exotel, and Twilio

children.text: We invested in making a beautiful and powerful design system called Espresso. It blends modernism and minimalism so that it helps the user focus on their core activity without being distracted by annoying design inconsistencies.

items.title: Responsive Design
items.description: Adapts to any screen size seamlessly.

items.title: Not just a product, but a community.
items.description: Frappe CRM is fully open source and backed by a vibrant, global community. You are never locked into one vendor. Join a global community where people help each other.

items.title: Don't pay per user.
items.description: Most CRM products charge per user. We don't think that's fair. Frappe products are priced based on compute, allowing you to start low and scale without per-seat penalties.

items.question: Is Frappe CRM open source?
items.answer: Yes. Frappe CRM is fully open source and backed by a global community, so you are never locked into a single vendor.

items.question: Do I pay per user?
items.answer: No. Frappe products are priced on compute rather than per seat, so you can start small and add users without per-seat penalties.

items.question: Can it connect to WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Exotel and Twilio?
items.answer: Yes. Frappe CRM works with WhatsApp Business API, pulls leads from Facebook and Instagram, and supports Exotel and Twilio for calls and SMS.

items.question: Can the CRM be customised for our sales process?
items.answer: Yes. It is built on the Frappe Framework, so you can add custom fields, new data models and Python automations. TruSync, a Frappe partner in Hyderabad, can set this up for you.

items.question: Does it work on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. It is a progressive web app that can be installed on iOS and Android and adapts to any screen size.

layout.heading: Start your CRM implementation
layout.body: Existing CRMs were too basic, too expensive, or closed source. So the Frappe team built their own, and now it is open for everyone. TruSync will set it up around your sales process.

items.question: Can ERPNext handle multi-level bills of materials?
items.answer: Yes. ERPNext supports multi-level BOMs with sub-assemblies and scrap management, and keeps versions with change logs.

items.question: Does ERPNext plan materials automatically?
items.answer: Yes. The MRP engine checks inventory against sales orders, calculates shortages and creates work orders and material requests.

items.question: Can we track serial numbers and batches?
items.answer: Yes. You can assign serial numbers for warranty tracking and control batches so expired materials are not used in production.

items.question: How is product cost calculated?
items.answer: Valuation includes material cost, landed costs such as freight and customs, and operational costs such as labour and power, using FIFO or moving average.
